Definition: neuter of the compound of a derivative of the base of 5111 (as adverb); more daringly, i.e. with greater confidence than otherwise:--the more boldly.
BiblicalUsage: More boldly — Paul's word for his own letter. He has written the more boldly to the Romans in some sort, as putting them in mind, because of the grace given him by God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the adverb is a small window into Paul's conscience: he knows he writes sharply, and he names the grace that lets him do it.
